description: Sends a charter quote request to Tokyo Charter Bus staff and returns a request reference. Call ONLY after the user has reviewed the details and explicitly confirmed sending them, and agreed to the privacy policy (set user_confirmed and privacy_consent to true). This does not book or reserve a vehicle; staff reply with a written quotation.

add_ons.description: Optional add-on vehicles, only together with this bus/coach request: private cars (taxi/hire-car licence) and luggage vans.

allow_auxiliary_seats.description: false = do not plan on fold-down auxiliary seats.

destination_prefecture.description: JIS prefecture code 01-47 of the main destination.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, empty for a one-day trip.

idempotency_key.description: Optional UUID to make retries safe.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for names and messages: en, ja, zh-CN, zh-TW, ko, th, id, fr, de, es or it. Defaults to en.

pickup_prefecture.description: JIS prefecture code 01-47 of the pick-up (e.g. 13 Tokyo, 12 Chiba for Narita).

privacy_consent.description: Must be true: the user agreed to the privacy policy for this request.

user_confirmed.description: Must be true: the user explicitly confirmed sending this request.

vehicle_type.description: Bus type, 'multiple', 'any', or 'alphard-7' for a 7-seat private car with driver (max 6 passengers per car; hire-car licence; quote only).

name: create_quote_request
title: Send a quote request
